pretrained_feature_actual_use.construction: dinov2_vits14_reg(pretrained=False) followed by strict official checkpoint load; pretrained=False is not random-feature execution

features_and_head.features: T context CLS; Q context patch bilinear at supplied q; F local96 CLS; C central32 CLS; P centre2x2 local patch mean; five384-descriptors plus8scalars
features_and_head.scalars: four descriptor cosines, three validity fractions, Q-inside flag
features_and_head.trainable_head: 1928 features + abs/product(T,C) + abs/product(Q,P) =>3464 ->64 ReLU->1;221825 parameters; output layer zero initialized
features_and_head.native_ID_feature: No native onehot in this inspected feature/head interface; q enters spatial token sampling/context geometry. Do not infer no spatial conditioning.

v121_natural_cue_probe.declared_units: 37 weak cue records /22 physical before-after frame pairs /44 RGB; 9 correlated shifts x2 views =666 rows; declarations only, no table recount
v121_natural_cue_probe.q: weak reference r + dx,dy in{-3,0,3}; original BEFORE q8 copy with carrier slot0 overwritten; other7 retained; L recomputed from substituted tuple; identical tuple/context/L for BEFORE and AFTER
v121_natural_cue_probe.target: Existing expected structural-cue-region D before/E after; same weak label across nine shifts even if material edge crosses q. Not per-query target-pixel membership, exact native corner, or coordinate verification.

C14_source_training_not_v121_fit.task: Binary D versus external E at supplied fixed q; S/U retained but excluded from binary loss. No learned self class or coordinate-correctness classifier.
C14_source_training_not_v121_fit.per_step: 128 known available TRAIN rows, D64/E64;16 samewood cover/sham pairs plus8 inherited matched pairs =>24 hinge pairs
C14_source_training_not_v121_fit.loss: mean BCE over128 known available rows +0.25*mean(max(0,2-(z_cover-z_sham))) over24 matched pairs
C14_source_training_not_v121_fit.optimizer: AdamW lr0.001 weight_decay0.001 clip5;2000 candidate updates; historical source selector over10 source-VAL BCE cohorts; no score values reopened
C14_source_training_not_v121_fit.C14_context_control: original/emulated q8 finite nonsentinel minmax, unclipped/unexpanded; source local q/L/crop96/teachers/sampler/loss unchanged relative C13; native_mapping UNKNOWN, conditional AUX not human gold
C14_source_training_not_v121_fit.representation_critical_note: This is paired logit ranking, not evidence of newly contrastively trained DINO embeddings.

minimal_candidate_ko: 새 backbone/추가 SAM부터 늘리지 말고, 동일 frozen DINO와 작은 head/0 decoder를 기준선으로 유지한 SOURCE-only paired data control이 최소 후보다. 원 query/q8/L을 보존한 intended-instance/part 근거와 같은-query COVER/SHAM의 실제 덮음·보존을 먼저 행별 권한 sidecar로 연결한다. 기존 cue/carrier 라벨을 native gold로 복사하지 않고 불명확 행은 UNKNOWN으로 남긴다. 새 target/자료 정의를 적용한 비교에서는 기존 BCE+hinge 기준선을 재사용하고, 추가 contrastive 목적이 있다면 같은 input/분모/계층적 SOURCE FIT-DEV 및 용량에서 그 목적만 분리한다. 이는 구현/학습 승인이나 성능 개선 주장이 아니다.
